title: More Outcome-based Work Arrangements, Rather Than Time-based Models
what_it_is: More Outcome-based Work Arrangements, Rather Than Time-based Models

sections.label: Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Requests
sections.summary: The Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangement Requests sets out the process for workers to request flexible work arrangements and for employers to consider requests on reasonable business grounds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangement Requests sets out the process for workers to formally request for flexible work arrangements and for employers to consider these requests on reasonable business grounds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As part of implementation, employers and workers should mutually agree on the outcomes and how to track them.

sections.label: Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health
sections.summary: The Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-being at Workplaces sets out good practices for employers supporting worker well-being, including reasonable expectations of after-hours work communications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-being at Workplaces sets out good practices for employers that support the well-being of their workers, including setting reasonable expectations of after-hours work communications and communicating them to employees.

sections.label: Flexible Work Arrangements Survey Results
sections.summary: There is no specific study measuring outcomes between flexible work arrangements and key performance, but survey results show flexible work arrangements rank first in preferred requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For the first supplementary question, there is no specific particular study that will measure specific outcomes between flexible work arrangements and key performance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: But our survey results, from the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) and also from our workers, show that flexible work arrangements are ranked number one in terms of preferred requirements, compared to other leave and even financial contributions.
